description: This file contains database migration functions for the Mattermost server, handling role and system configuration migrations, content flagging properties setup, and other schema updates.

methods.name: DoAdvancedPermissionsMigration
methods.description: Migrates default roles to the database and updates configuration.

methods.name: SetPhase2PermissionsMigrationStatus
methods.description: Marks the second phase of permissions migration as complete or deletes its record.

methods.name: DoEmojisPermissionsMigration
methods.description: Migrates emoji permissions to the database and updates roles.

methods.name: DoGuestRolesCreationMigration
methods.description: Creates default guest roles and updates schemes accordingly.

methods.name: DoSystemConsoleRolesCreationMigration
methods.description: Creates system console roles if not already present.

methods.name: doSingleRoleCreationMigration
methods.description: Creates a specific role if not already created, based on migration key and role ID.

methods.name: doCustomGroupAdminRoleCreationMigration
methods.description: Creates custom group admin role if not already created.

methods.name: doSharedChannelManagerRoleCreationMigration
methods.description: Creates shared channel manager role if not already created.

methods.name: doSecureConnectionManagerRoleCreationMigration
methods.description: Creates secure connection manager role if not already created.

methods.name: doContentExtractionConfigDefaultTrueMigration
methods.description: Sets default content extraction config to true.

methods.name: doPlaybooksRolesCreationMigration
methods.description: Creates default roles for playbooks and schemes.

methods.name: doFirstAdminSetupCompleteMigration
methods.description: Marks the first admin setup as complete based on post count and existing data.

methods.name: doRemainingSchemaMigrations
methods.description: Performs remaining schema updates, such as assigning invite IDs to teams.

methods.name: doPostPriorityConfigDefaultTrueMigration
methods.description: Sets default post priority configuration to true.

methods.name: doSetupContentFlaggingProperties
methods.description: Sets up content flagging properties in the system, creating or updating property fields.

methods.name: doCloudS3PathMigrations
methods.description: Schedules a job to migrate S3 file paths if in cloud environment.

methods.name: doDeleteEmptyDraftsMigration
methods.description: Schedules a job to delete empty drafts.

methods.name: doDeleteOrphanDraftsMigration
methods.description: Schedules a job to delete orphan drafts.

methods.name: doDeleteDmsPreferencesMigration
methods.description: Schedules a job to delete DMS preferences.

methods.name: doAppMigrations
methods.description: Runs all core application migrations sequentially.
